question.worked_solution:
If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(0.75),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}(0.25)^{x-1}(0.75), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<5) & =P(X\in \{1,2,3\}) \\  & =P(X=1)+P(X=2)+P(X=3)+P(X=4) \\  & =f(1)+f(2)+f(3)+f(4) \\  & =(0.25)^{0}(0.75)+(0.25)^{1}(0.75)+(0.25)^{2}(0.75)+(0.25)^{3}(0.75) \\  & ≈0.9961.\end{aligned}
$$
